defect: None. This is a real merged commit in a real repository, and its cleanliness is a fact about the world rather than a claim by its author.
why_it_is_hard: The fix adds a module-level unique symbol and two branches of newline normalisation that look arbitrary without knowing that text inputs strip CR/LF from value while defaultValue keeps them. A reviewer that does not know that reads the regex as a magic string.

expected_detection.objection: The pre-hydration value is captured only when `el.type` is `text` or `textarea`, so v-model on `search`, `email`, `url`, `tel` and `password` is unchanged — the fix covers two of six text-entry types. Separately, the newline normalisation the change exists for is exercised by nothing: the one added test uses the values 'server value' and 'user value', neither of which contains a newline.
expected_detection.verified_by: read against vModel.ts and the added hydration test at the pinned head on 2026-08-27; the reviewer raised both across six reviews in two rounds

pinned_repository.subject: fix(v-model): preserve text input before hydration (#14411)

notes: Drawn from a merged commit. Adds a symbol key to a shared element type, which is a plausible scope finding that is not one. Moved to `contested`. Its contract was rewritten once to test whether the objection was mine rather than the code's; it was the code's, and the rewrite moved nothing.
